purpose: Bounded cadence validation of the unauthenticated public REVE web feed before any national sweep or runtime integration.

interpretation.reason: Twenty consecutive bounded public pages completed successfully in about 68 seconds and returned the station/connectivity data needed for first-pass inventory work. This is materially faster than the documented external API collector and is sufficient to continue progressive validation.
notYetProven: national pagination completeness without holes or duplicates
stability of CPO/operator identities across the full public feed
longer-run rate limiting or service protection behavior
full semantic parity of tariffs and operational status with the documented external API
interpretation.historical618Rule: Do not treat current public-feed identities as proven members of the lost frozen 618-label historical snapshot. legacyWorkLabelCount remains 618 and current-feed identities must retain reconstruction provenance.

nextSafeStep: Increase the bounded public-feed validation progressively, explicitly count unique location IDs and operator/CPO labels, detect pagination duplicates/gaps, and use any genuinely new durable nominative identities only as provenance-tagged reconstruction candidates. Do not promote the public feed to runtime TCC or claim historical-618 membership without evidence.
